players.product: Vera Rubin platform (Rubin GPU, Vera CPU, NVLink switch, Spectrum-X / Quantum-X networking)

connects_to.relationship: NVIDIA AI infrastructure deployments committed through 2030 (~12 GW), incl. Portsmouth 4.25 GW site

contracts.signal: NVIDIA's partnership with SB Energy covers the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, where SB Energy will build, own and operate the data center under a 20-year lease to OpenAI; OpenAI will use the initial capacity to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform (GPUs, CPUs and networking). Beyond the initial capacity, NVIDIA can secure approximately an additional 3.8 gigawatts at the site at its sole discretion (Item 1.01; the press release describes an option to take the remaining 3.75 IT-GW), OpenAI will be the customer for 8 IT-GW, and ready-for-service is expected beginning in 2028.
contracts.units: option on approximately an additional 3.8 gigawatts (press release: remaining 3.75 IT-GW); OpenAI customer for 8 IT-GW
contracts.type: AI factory campus deployment under 20-year lease to OpenAI
